name: An intro can be created using 3 methods: Method 1 - Directly quoting a key melody sentence/refrain from the song

then.description: An intro can be created using 3 methods: Method 1 - Directly quoting a key melody sentence/refrain from the song; Method 2 - Taking a melodic motif/rhythmic figure from the song and sequentially developing it (mô tiến); Method 3 - Composing a new melody over a standard chord progression (e.g., I - vi - ii - V - I or IV - iii - ii - V - I).
